fix: 'leaf blade X' should go to leaf lamina, not leaf
reason: The flora says the blade is lorate. Lorate = strap-shaped (PATO_0002430) is right, but the bearer should be the lamina.
Petals unlobed = petal, lobed, negated.
Stems densely hirsute: stem pilosity hirsute.

target: intermediate of oblong (PATO_0000946) and obovate (PATO_0001891), or shape with both operands
fix: A hyphenated shape 'X-Y' (oblong-obovate) describes a shape between X and Y. Keep both parts, not just the first.
reason: The inner context (FLOPO_0991378) is right, but 'oblong' alone drops 'obovate'.

fix: In 'tube ..., N times as long as sepals' after 'Corolla', the tube is the bearer.
reason: The length ratio to the sepals is said of the corolla tube, not the whole corolla.

fix: In 'Inflorescences with involucres in small clusters ..., greenish', the colour follows the involucres or their clusters, not the inflorescence head word.
reason: In Chorizanthe the greenish part is the involucre. The reading is somewhat ambiguous.

fix: A sub-part named after a semicolon inside an organ entry ('lower lip oblong, subpatent') is the bearer, not the organ that heads the entry.
reason: Subpatent is said of the lower lip. Also, 'sub-' (nearly) should carry an approximate qualifier.

fix: In 'colour + indumentum' ('whitish to brownish puberulous'), the colour belongs to the hairs. Also, 'densely' qualifies puberulous, not whitish.
reason: The petiole is not whitish to brownish; its fine hairs are.
Fruit not stipitate: negated stipitate on fruit.

fix: 'the segments' of a corolla united at the base means the corolla lobes.
reason: Connivent is said of the corolla segments. The 'old' context and the negation are right.

fix: 'beneath' / 'above' after an indumentum value is a place slot (abaxial / adaxial). It must not be dropped.
reason: The leaflet is glabrous above. Without 'beneath', the annotation wrongly says the whole leaflet is subglabrous to pilose.

fix: The apex of a tepal should map to tepal apex, not petal apex.
reason: The outer part is tepals (Zigadenus), not petals.

target: PO_0020122 inflorescence axis (umbel ray, primary branch)
fix: In Apiaceae, 'rays' are the branches of a compound umbel, not ray flowers.
reason: 'rays 6-16, subequal' describes umbel branches.

fix: 'glaucous' should go to PATO glaucous (waxy bloom), not to colour green.
reason: Buds glaucous means covered with a bloom, not green.
Sheaths more or less pilose: approximately pilose on the leaf sheath.

fix: A quality after 'apex ...,' in the same clause belongs to the apex.
reason: In this moss, the leaf apex is the part that is or isn't fragile.
Stamens shorter than petals.

fix: In 'internodes of distal branches ...', the internode is the bearer and the branch is only where it sits.
reason: The ribbing is said of the internodes when young.
Capsules equaling calyx: length ratio 1 to the calyx.
Sepals 6.
Blade abaxially glabrous: abaxial epidermis of the lamina, glabrous.
Stipules adnate to petiole.

target: FLOPO_0991117 cauline (bearer context), or PO_0000013 cauline leaf
fix: 'Cauline leaves absent' must keep 'cauline'. Otherwise it says the plant has no leaves.
reason: Basal leaves are present (rosette), so 'leaf absent' is false.
Stigma unlobed.

fix: 'X, Y or Z at the apex' puts the shape on the apex. The alternatives list must keep all operands; 'acute' (PATO_0001857) is missing.
reason: The shapes are of the blade apex, and the first alternative, acute, was lost.
Basal leaf blade 2-8 mm wide, in the basal context.
Semi-amplexicaul means half-clasping. Clasping on the leaf is an acceptable reading, though the 'semi-' degree is lost.
Petals subequal: approximately equal size.
Style slightly longer than stamens.
Stigmas brownish.
